assessments.reasoning: The cited passage restricts non-hidden fields in the result to fields permitted by each closed operand. It explicitly exempts hidden fields.

challenge.method: Compare the rule with the same passage’s named field, pattern constraint, one-operand ellipsis and nested-struct clauses.
challenge.results: One operand’s ellipsis cannot admit a field on behalf of another operand. Operand-level admission alone also does not guarantee value compatibility or nested admission.

limitations: The evidence supports the necessary admission condition for non-hidden fields. It does not establish successful unification of the associated values.
